item.title: 300km in 24 Hours - My Malaysia Ultra Solo Ride Record in Casual Gear
item.description:
This journey stands as Chapter 2 and the grand finale of my twenties endurance series. It is the direct sequel to my 200 km mountain expedition: Pitch Black Detours and 2,000m+ Climbs: How I Conquered Fraser’s Hill Solo.

“You don’t need carbon fiber or expensive kit to conquer massive distances—just a solid bike, a plan, and the mental grit to push through.”

item.title: Pitch Black Detours and 2,000m+ Climbs: How I Conquered Fraser’s Hill Solo
item.description: A 20-hour, 200km solo gravel ride through pitch-black forest detours, surprise livestock encounters, pro paceline drafts, and 2,208m of climbing to Fraser's Hill—the foundational crucible that paved the way for my 300km graduation challenge.
